summary.en: One icon hops for attention, each jump higher, squashing on every landing, while the camera is drawn to it and the rest goes soft.
summary.zh: 一个图标原地连跳讨关注，一次比一次高，每次落地压扁，镜头被它吸过去，其余画面虚掉。

fits: Introducing one new feature or app as a performer at half-screen size, before it opens its panel.
notFor: Small icons in a corner (no one sees the performance); text; more than once a film; serious or editorial films.

intent.en: A new feature asks to be noticed, louder each time, so the viewer looks at it before it opens.
intent.zh: 一个新功能一次比一次大声地讨关注，让观众在它打开之前先把目光投过去。

content.en: One icon or app tile in the scene (its rect), shown large (about half the screen); no text.
content.zh: 画面里的一个图标或应用方块（给出它的位置框），拍得够大（约半屏）；不需要文字。

fits.zh: 把一个新功能或新应用当作表演者引出来：半屏大小的图标，在它弹开面板之前。

notFor.zh: 角落里的小图标（没人看得见这场表演）；文字；一支片用两次以上；严肃、编辑感的片子。

pairs.note: after the last landing the icon can open into its panel

en: Leave headroom: the last hop rises 1.2 times the icon height plus the push; measure the top margin or it leaves the frame.
A small icon gets lost: the hop only reads at about half-screen size.
Each landing wants a rising "duk"; silent hops lose half their weight.
zh: 先留够上方空间：末跳高 1.2 倍图标高再加推近，量好上留白，否则顶出画框。
图标小了就看不见：这套弹跳只在约半屏大时成立。
每次落地配一声音调递升的“咚”，无声的弹跳少一半分量。

upstream.name: 注意力弹跳
upstream.summary: 图标表演——attention-bounce 求关注弹跳（图标连跳递增+落地压扁+镜头被吸引）
upstream.use: 半屏级 icon 特写段落；新功能引出
